page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor, lacks local storage, and has a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.sn1.xlarge exhibits modest performance profiles across most workloads. In stress-ng CPU tests, both single-core and multi-core performance fall in the bottom 25%. Similarly, Geekbench single-core and text processing benchmarks rank in the bottom 10%. However, the instance demonstrates average performance in Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests, as well as in large-block memory write bandwidth. For lightweight language model tasks, the server achieves average prompt processing and text generation speeds with a 135M model, though performance drops to the bottom 10% for text generation with a 7B model.

The lack of local storage and the 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth represent notable hardware constraints. Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance is structured for compute-focused tasks that do not require high memory density. Qualitatively, the dedicated CPU allocation provides stable execution, but the lower-tier benchmark results suggest it is best suited for non-critical compute workloads, basic software compilation, or lightweight web serving rather than memory-intensive databases or high-throughput data processing.
